facts.fact: Gleba TV reports that the digital identity initiative under the World Bank-financed STP Digital project foresees closer coordination between the civil registry, civil identification, migration and border services.

STP.note: Nothing on digital registration of births or deaths.
Data protection is named only as a principle of the initiative; no law is stated.
No count or share of people holding the ID.
Nothing on a number given at birth.
Nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
Nothing on a public register keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: Gleba TV reports that the Directorate-General of Registry and Notary received five biometric enrolment kits for missions abroad, as part of building the National Digital Identity System under the World Bank-financed STP Digital project, with installation due to start from December 2026.

systems.owner: Direcao-Geral do Registo e do Notariado

STP.note: Kits enrol identity data for the ID system; nothing on local civil registration offices entering births or deaths.
